svg.title: SenseBridge knowledge graph
svg.desc: 340 of the most connected symbols in the SenseBridge repository, laid out as a force-directed graph and joined by 670 extracted relationships — imports, calls, definitions, and references. Nodes are coloured by subsystem: app · Swift/SwiftUI, website · Astro, docs, tools · scripts · CI, audits · legal · models · security, root orientation docs. The 16 most connected are named. Pulses travel the edges to show how the subsystems connect. Generated by tools/graph-visual.mjs from the Graphify knowledge graph at commit 741abd1.
